name: k6 framework-person matrix
tagline: Intensity × cache matrix for person Query APIs (load/stress/spike/soak/ceiling).
description: Python MatrixPlanner expands endpoint × profile × intensity (low/med/high) × cache (uncached/cached) cells, pins RANDOM_SEED, invokes k6 via K6ProcessRunner, then refreshes the dashboard with build_manifests.py --k6-only. Scenario details live in k6/framework-person/README.md.

commands.cmd: MODE=smoke python3 k6/framework-person/run_all.py query load med
commands.blurb: One VU / one iteration per planned cell

notes: Keywords AND across axes (endpoint/profile/intensity/cache); OR within an axis
RANDOM_SEED=20260623 is always pinned by run_all.py
CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE=true keeps going after a failed cell
TEST_FILTER accepts comma-separated keywords (same as CLI args)
